abstract.para: Cetacean (whale, dolphin, porpoise) sightings and on-effort visual line-transect survey segments from quarterly CalCOFI cruises, 2004-2022 (effort through 2021). Curated by the Scripps Whale Acoustics Lab (Hildebrand / Baumann-Pickering) and staged from the CalCOFI marine mammal Shiny app repository (CalCOFI/marmam-app). The same cruises also carry the Farallon Institute's seabird and marine mammal survey (farallon_bird-mammal), run by an independent observer team: both datasets are kept, so a cetacean group seen by both teams appears once in each, and summing the two counts the same animals twice. The behaviour codes (primary and other behaviour) are held back: they are bare numeric codes with no codebook yet (Q03), so no behaviour rows are published until the lab supplies one; they remain in the archived source.

description.para: QC flags present: No. Each counted sighting carries the analyst-adjusted on-effort/on-transect flag as obs_attribute effort_status (ON/OFF); line-transect density uses ON only. A sighting with a Best group size of 0 or blank (animals seen but not counted) keeps its sample row and publishes no obs.

dataTable.entityDescription: One row per physical sampling event at its native grain (site, tow, net, subsample, cast, bottle, water, filter, underway, transect, sighting, deployment, scan, region pool). An adjacency list: parent_sample_key points at the containing event and root_sample_key at the top of the chain, so counting distinct events at any level is a single GROUP BY.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Globally unique event key, namespaced dataset_key:sample_type:id so the same integer id in two datasets — or at two event levels in one dataset — never collides.

attribute.attributeDefinition: One UBIGINT H3 cell at resolution 7: the parent of the resolution-10 cell of this event's own latitude / longitude (not the resolution-7 cell the position falls in), defined exactly as obs_bio.hex7 / obs_env.hex7; NULL without a finite position. Lets a per-sample value in sample_measurement be drawn in hexagons. An observation carries its own position, so a CTD scan can sit in another cell than its cast.

dataTable.entityDescription: The occurrence-headline long table: one scalar measurement per row, environmental (realm = 'env') and biological (realm = 'bio') together. Biological taxon is the global taxon_key; sub-occurrence detail (length/stage bins, behavior) lives in obs_attribute, and event-level effort in sample_measurement.
